entries.en: Please refer to the diagram before connecting the two cables.
entries.zh: 连接这两根电缆前，请查阅示意图。

entries.en: We must take action before another branch falls onto the playground.
entries.zh: 我们必须采取行动，免得再有树枝掉到操场上。

entries.en: I hope to catch some z's before the overnight train leaves.
entries.zh: 我希望在夜班火车发车前打个盹儿。

entries.en: That is a task we should confine to experienced volunteers.
entries.zh: 那是一项我们应该仅交给有经验的志愿者承担的任务。

entries.en: The committee changed the selection rules ex post facto.
entries.zh: 委员会事后更改了选拔规则。

entries.en: These unexpected delays have to do with a missing permit.
entries.zh: 这些意外延误与一份缺失的许可证有关。

entries.en: He began to hit the bottle every night after losing his job.
entries.zh: 失业后，他开始每晚酗酒。

entries.en: In common with several neighbors, we opposed the road extension.
entries.zh: 和几位邻居一样，我们反对延长那条路。

entries.en: Like fun I'm paying for the window you broke!
entries.zh: 我才不会为你打破的窗户付钱呢！

entries.en: The school meted out identical punishments to both students.
entries.zh: 学校给予了两名学生相同的处罚。

entries.en: These are crimes they cannot pin on an innocent bystander.
entries.zh: 他们不能把这些罪行归咎于一个无辜的旁观者。

entries.meaningZh: 拒绝作危害自己的证词〔法律用语〕
entries.en: The witness chose to take the fifth when asked about the missing funds.
entries.zh: 被问及失踪的资金时，证人选择拒绝作可能对自己不利的证词。

entries.meaningZh: 给汽车底部涂防护层〔英式〕
entries.en: The mechanic undersealed the car before returning it to its owner.
entries.zh: 修理工给汽车底部涂了防护层，才把车交还车主。

entries.en: Please knock instead of trying to barge into my office.
entries.zh: 请先敲门，别想着鲁莽地闯进我的办公室。

entries.en: Nobody wants to be cooped up indoors during the holidays.
entries.zh: 谁也不想假期里被闷在屋子里，不能外出。

entries.en: Your announcement may be drowned out by the crowd's cheering.
entries.zh: 你的广播通知可能会被人群的欢呼声盖过。

entries.en: Please be on the lookout for a small dog with a red collar.
entries.zh: 请留意寻找一只戴红色项圈的小狗。

entries.en: Calling this a palace would be stretching it rather a lot.
entries.zh: 把这里称为宫殿，就实在有点说过头了。

entries.meaningZh: 因突如其来的事情而吃惊
entries.en: Don't be taken aback if the usually quiet audience asks difficult questions.
entries.zh: 平时安静的观众若提出难答的问题，别感到吃惊。

entries.meaningZh: 逐渐混在一起而难以区分
entries.en: The distant hills blur into each other in the evening mist.
entries.zh: 远处的山峦在暮霭中渐渐混成一片，难以区分。

entries.en: A proposal to share the costs could break the deadlock.
entries.zh: 分摊费用的提议或许能打破僵局。

entries.en: Don't brood over one awkward conversation for the rest of the week.
entries.zh: 别在接下来的一周里一直为一次尴尬的谈话烦恼。

entries.meaningZh: 下倾盆大雨〔英式，非正式〕
entries.en: Rain began to bucket down as we reached the bus shelter.
entries.zh: 我们到达公交候车亭时，开始下起了倾盆大雨。

entries.en: He can't be bothered to sort the old photographs by date.
entries.zh: 他懒得把那些旧照片按日期整理。

entries.en: The two contestants began to confer furtively behind the stage curtain.
entries.zh: 两名参赛者开始在舞台幕布后悄悄商议。

entries.en: She couldn't care less about the color of the invitation envelopes.
entries.zh: 她完全不在乎邀请函信封的颜色。

entries.meaningZh: 眯起眼睛而使眼周出现细纹
entries.en: His eyes crinkle up when he laughs at his own jokes.
entries.zh: 他被自己讲的笑话逗笑时，眼睛便眯起来，眼周泛起细纹。

entries.en: You will need to crouch down to see beneath the bench.
entries.zh: 你得蹲下，才能看到长凳下面。

entries.en: Our discussion began to drift off on a tangent about holiday photographs.
entries.zh: 我们的讨论说着说着就偏离主题，扯到了假期照片上。

entries.en: I watched the guests drift over towards the refreshment table.
entries.zh: 我看着宾客们慢悠悠地朝茶点桌走过去。

entries.en: We should entertain the possibility that the keys never left this room.
entries.zh: 我们应该认真考虑钥匙根本没有离开过这个房间的可能性。

entries.en: He hurried across the platform to fall in step beside me.
entries.zh: 他快步穿过站台，走到我身旁与我并步而行。

entries.en: You can flick through the catalog while I check the stockroom.
entries.zh: 我去库房查看时，你可以快速翻翻目录。

entries.en: Please don't get worked up over a mistake we can easily correct.
entries.zh: 请别为一个我们很容易纠正的错误而激动。

entries.meaningZh: 情绪失控；异常激动〔非正式〕
entries.en: The fans will go bonkers if their captain scores again.
entries.zh: 队长若再得分，球迷们会激动得失去控制。

entries.en: You have guts to question the director in front of everyone.
entries.zh: 你真有胆量，敢当着所有人的面质疑导演。

entries.en: She would have none of it when we proposed postponing practice.
entries.zh: 我们提议推迟训练，她却坚决不接受。

entries.meaningZh: 有实质内容或一定根据
entries.en: Her objections have substance, even if the committee dislikes her tone.
entries.zh: 她的异议有根据，即使委员会不喜欢她的语气。

entries.en: These sketches have the makings of a lively picture book.
entries.zh: 这些草图具备发展成一本生动图画书的潜质。

entries.en: The low ceiling forced us to hunch up beside the window.
entries.zh: 天花板太低，迫使我们在窗边弓起了身子。

entries.en: Without that small loan, our workshop could not keep afloat.
entries.zh: 没有那笔小额贷款，我们的工坊就无法维持运转。

entries.en: I saw the cat leap up when the door slammed.
entries.zh: 我看见门砰地关上时，那只猫突然跳了起来。

entries.meaningZh: 显得刻意费力而不自然
entries.en: The transitions still look laboured despite several rounds of editing.
entries.zh: 尽管已修改好几轮，衔接处看上去依旧刻意生硬。

entries.en: I will not tell a soul where you hid the spare key.
entries.zh: 我不会告诉任何人你把备用钥匙藏在了哪里。

entries.en: The candidate tried to play up to the audience's distrust of outsiders.
entries.zh: 那名候选人试图迎合观众对外来者的不信任。

entries.en: Sunlight began to pour through the gap in the curtains.
entries.zh: 阳光开始从窗帘的缝隙大量照进来。

entries.en: You can redeem yourself by helping to repair the damage.
entries.zh: 你可以帮忙修复损坏的地方，以此将功补过。

entries.meaningZh: 在其他办法无效时采取某种手段
entries.en: We may have to resort to candles if the lights fail again.
entries.zh: 如果电灯再次失灵，我们可能只好用蜡烛。

entries.en: Her eyes began to rove over the shelves behind the desk.
entries.zh: 她的目光开始在书桌后的书架上扫来扫去。

entries.en: We watched the last customer saunter out with his newspaper.
entries.zh: 我们看着最后一名顾客拿着报纸慢悠悠地走了出去。

entries.en: Her initial excitement began to seep away during the long wait.
entries.zh: 在漫长的等待中，她起初的兴奋逐渐消退。

entries.en: A second unexplained withdrawal should set off alarm bells at the bank.
entries.zh: 第二笔无法解释的取款应该让银行警觉起来。

entries.meaningZh: 因不愿面对而退缩或回避
entries.en: She refused to shrink back from the difficult conversation.
entries.zh: 她不愿回避那场难以开口的谈话。

entries.meaningZh: 把信息不知不觉塞进脑海
entries.en: These are assumptions the author tries to smuggle into our thinking.
entries.zh: 作者试图把这些假设悄悄塞进我们的思想中。

entries.meaningZh: 振作起来；摆脱消极状态
entries.en: I needed a brisk walk to snap out of it after the disappointing interview.
entries.zh: 那次令人失望的面试之后，我需要快步走一走来振作起来。

entries.meaningZh: 设法调和根本矛盾的要求
entries.en: We cannot square the circle of lower fees and unlimited personal tuition.
entries.zh: 我们无法调和既降低费用又提供无限量个人辅导这两种矛盾的要求。

entries.en: I watched her stalk off without waiting for an apology.
entries.zh: 我看着她愤然大步离开，没有等对方道歉。

entries.en: He tried to steal a glance at the clock behind me.
entries.zh: 他试图偷偷瞥一眼我身后的时钟。

entries.en: Such rumors only stoke up resentment between the two clubs.
entries.zh: 这样的谣言只会助长两个俱乐部之间的怨恨。

entries.en: Don't storm off before we have settled who will pay.
entries.zh: 在我们商定由谁付款前，别怒气冲冲地走掉。

entries.en: She threatened to storm out if the chair interrupted her again.
entries.zh: 她扬言，主持人如果再打断她，她就要愤然离场。

entries.en: He remained studiedly polite while asking us to leave.
entries.zh: 他叫我们离开时，依然刻意保持着客气。

entries.en: A sharp whistle made both guards wheel round at once.
entries.zh: 一声尖锐的哨声让两名守卫立刻猛地转过身来。

entries.en: The instructor broke the routine into small, learnable steps.
entries.zh: 教练把整套动作拆成了一个个可学会的小步骤。

entries.en: The dark bread had a rich, malty aroma.
entries.zh: 那块深色面包散发着浓郁的麦芽香气。

entries.en: The novel explores tensions within a patrilocal household.
entries.zh: 小说探讨了一个婚后居住在男方家的家庭内部的矛盾。

entries.en: The restorationist removed a layer of soot from the ceiling.
entries.zh: 修复者除去了天花板上的一层烟灰。

entries.en: The seminar compared two supersymmetric models without favoring either one.
entries.zh: 研讨会比较了两个超对称模型，没有偏向其中任何一个。

entries.en: A multifactor analysis revealed no single explanation for the delay.
entries.zh: 多因素分析显示，这次延误不能由某一个因素单独解释。

entries.en: The lecturer highlighted the cerebellopontine region on the anatomical diagram.
entries.zh: 讲师在解剖图上标出了小脑脑桥区。

entries.en: This ultraportable projector fits inside the front pocket of my bag.
entries.zh: 这个极轻便的投影仪能放进我包的前袋。

entries.en: The lawyer challenged the witness's perjurious testimony during the hearing.
entries.zh: 律师在听证会上对证人的虚假证词提出了质疑。

entries.en: The lecturer replaced an outdated chart of the Uranian system.
entries.zh: 讲师换掉了一张过时的天王星系统图。

entries.en: Her reductionistic account ignored the role of family relationships.
entries.zh: 她那种还原论式的解释忽略了家庭关系的作用。

entries.en: His quivery voice steadied as he continued reading the letter.
entries.zh: 他继续读信，颤抖的声音渐渐平稳下来。

entries.en: The laboratory stored the bioactive compound in a clearly marked vial.
entries.zh: 实验室把这种生物活性化合物存放在一个标记清楚的小瓶中。

entries.en: The technician checked the radiometric measurements before printing the report.
entries.zh: 技术员在打印报告前核查了辐射度测量数据。

entries.en: I found his smirky expression more irritating than his words.
entries.zh: 比起他说的话，他那得意假笑的神情更让我恼火。

entries.en: The student identified the cricoid on the plastic teaching model.
entries.zh: 学生在塑料教学模型上认出了环状软骨。

entries.en: The auditor investigated an aberrational payment outside the usual approval process.
entries.zh: 审计员调查了一笔脱离常规审批流程的异常付款。

entries.en: The researcher placed the epigraphic notes beside photographs of the monument.
entries.zh: 研究员把题铭研究笔记放在那座纪念碑的照片旁。

entries.en: The display has a switchable backlight for use in dark rooms.
entries.zh: 这个显示屏配有可通过开关控制的背光，便于在暗室使用。

entries.en: An unescorted visitor waited outside the locked gallery.
entries.zh: 一名无人陪同的访客在上锁的展厅外等候。

entries.en: I wish there were a surefire way to keep squirrels off the roof.
entries.zh: 我真希望有个准能奏效的办法，让松鼠不上屋顶。

entries.en: We tested the multipoint connection before adding another terminal.
entries.zh: 添加另一台终端前，我们测试了多点连接。

entries.en: The biologist marked the ectoplasmic layer in the cell image.
entries.zh: 生物学家在细胞图像中标出了外质层。

entries.en: The archivist tied the unpaged manuscript with a cotton ribbon.
entries.zh: 档案管理员用棉带捆好了那份未标页码的手稿。

entries.en: The mechanic declared the van drivable after replacing its damaged tire.
entries.zh: 换掉破损轮胎后，修理工表示这辆货车可以驾驶了。

entries.en: They repaired the weatherbeaten sign instead of replacing it.
entries.zh: 他们修好了那块遭风雨侵蚀的招牌，没有换新的。

entries.en: Her tropological reading treated the locked garden as a symbol of grief.
entries.zh: 她的比喻性解读把那座上锁的花园看作悲伤的象征。

entries.en: A mustardy dressing gave the potato salad a sharp flavor.
entries.zh: 带芥末味的调味汁让土豆沙拉有了辛辣味。

entries.en: The village bucko backed away when the two farmers confronted him.
entries.zh: 村里那个欺凌弱小的人在两名农民上前质问时退缩了。

entries.en: The carless household relies on bicycles for most local trips.
entries.zh: 这个没有汽车的家庭在附近出行时主要靠自行车。

entries.en: The historian examined the proscriptive orders that excluded dissidents from office.
entries.zh: 历史学家研究了那些禁止异议人士任职的命令。

entries.en: That sucky rehearsal left everyone tired and disappointed.
entries.zh: 那场令人不快的排练让所有人都疲惫又失望。

entries.en: The francophile editor added several French novels to the reading list.
entries.zh: 那位亲法的编辑在阅读书单中增加了几本法国小说。

entries.en: The analyst compared the autoregressive model with a simpler baseline.
entries.zh: 分析员把自回归模型与一个更简单的基准模型作了比较。

entries.en: The researchers compared the stimulatory effects of two light settings.
entries.zh: 研究人员比较了两种光照设置的刺激作用。

entries.en: The essay distinguishes descriptive claims from ascriptive claims about responsibility.
entries.zh: 这篇文章区分了描述性陈述与涉及责任归属的陈述。

entries.en: The engineer checked the thermomechanical model against the test results.
entries.zh: 工程师用试验结果核对了热机械模型。

entries.en: The illustrator painted Charon beside a dark boat on the river.
entries.zh: 插画师把冥河摆渡神画在河上一条暗色小船旁。

entries.en: The unanalysed samples remained in a sealed box overnight.
entries.zh: 那些尚未分析的样本在密封箱里放了一夜。

entries.en: The botanist drew the biserial arrangement of leaves in her notebook.
entries.zh: 植物学家在笔记本上画出了叶片双列排列的方式。

entries.en: The most expensive proposal remained undiscussed when the meeting ended.
entries.zh: 会议结束时，费用最高的提议仍未得到讨论。

entries.en: We measured the cupboard before choosing a tankless water heater.
entries.zh: 选购即热式热水器前，我们测量了橱柜的尺寸。

entries.en: The essay treats the visual changes as epiphenomenal rather than causal.
entries.zh: 这篇文章把视觉变化视为附带现象，而非原因。

entries.meaningZh: 最引人注目的；最华丽的
entries.en: She chose the plain silver clasp instead of the showiest one.
entries.zh: 她选了朴素的银色搭扣，而没有选最华丽的那个。

entries.en: The company postponed its intercoastal shipment until the repairs were complete.
entries.zh: 公司把两岸间的货运推迟到维修完成之后。

entries.en: The actor's caricatural gestures made the serious scene unexpectedly comic.
entries.zh: 演员滑稽夸张的动作使严肃的场景意外地变得好笑。

entries.en: The canalside cafe closed early during the repair work.
entries.zh: 那家运河边的咖啡馆在维修期间早早关门。

entries.en: The technician checked the releasable latch before lifting the cover.
entries.zh: 技术员在掀起盖子前检查了可释放的锁扣。

entries.en: The proof assumes a normed space but does not require completeness.
entries.zh: 这项证明假设所讨论的是赋范空间，但不要求它是完备的。
